verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a consolidated platform covering corporate cards, expense management, global payments/bill pay, and multi-currency banking (Jeeves Cash) all in one product suite, with integrations to accounting tools (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero) reinforcing the 'replace point solutions' narrative. Missing for 10: independent/third-party validation (e.g., customer case studies or reviews) confirming actual consolidation in practice rather than only vendor marketing claims.
